clips.title: The story
paras: Agamand Mills lie in ruin across northern Tirisfal, now the Scourge’s largest stronghold in the region. The wealthy Agamand dynasty once held this farm and milling estate.

The Agamand family built its estate around a vast milling network across northern Tirisfal. When the Scourge swept across Lordaeron during the Third War, patriarch Gregor Agamand refused to flee. He fortified the compound and persuaded his retainers and laborers to stand with him. Their provisions and stone walls might have held, but their youngest son, Devlin Agamand, betrayed them. Devlin slaughtered the estate watchmen and let the walking dead into the sleeping quarters. Crippled from within, the remaining defenders fell, and the family joined the mindless ranks of the undead.

Agamand Mills are the Scourge’s strongest hold in Tirisfal Glades, and a direct threat to the Forsaken realm. Rotting windmills turn above fields crawling with wights, zombies, and skeletal horrors. Beneath the estate, Captain Dargol commands the garrison from the Agamand Family Crypt, where he practices necromancy to reanimate generations of Agamand ancestors. From Brill, Magistrate Sevren and the Deathguards fight to clear the mills and purge the Scourge before it can march on the Undercity.
